# Public recognition fixture

`6930-75918-0000.wav` is derived from recording `6930-75918-0000` in the LibriSpeech test-clean corpus. LibriSpeech was prepared by Vassil Panayotov with the assistance of Daniel Povey, from LibriVox audiobook recordings. Dataset citation: Vassil Panayotov, Guoguo Chen, Daniel Povey and Sanjeev Khudanpur, _LibriSpeech: an ASR corpus based on public domain audio books_, ICASSP 2015.

The corpus is [CC-BY-4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), as declared by [OpenSLR resource 12](https://www.openslr.org/12/) and the [dataset card](https://huggingface.co/datasets/openslr/librispeech_asr/blob/71cacbfb7e2354c4226d01e70d77d5fca3d04ba1/README.md). It retains those terms, independently of the app's AGPL licence. The manifest records the original recording ID, retrieval endpoint, dataset-card revision and hashes. The viewer asset endpoint is a retrieval source, not an assertion that it provides commit-addressed audio; the committed WAV hash fixes the actual test bytes.

Retrieved 24 November 2026 from the Hugging Face dataset viewer. Modification: decode the served FLAC to 16 kHz mono signed-16-bit PCM WAV, with no trimming, amplification or text changes. The source FLAC hash is retained in the manifest. Conversion used PyAV 19.0.2 directly (`av.open`, decode audio frames, write mono s16 samples with Python's wave module). The normal tests need only the committed WAV; they do not download datasets or use PyAV's file-decoding helper.

The reference transcript is **CONCORD RETURNED TO ITS PLACE AMIDST THE TENTS**. Preserve it independently of the model output. The pinned tiny.en baseline emits “Concorde”, a one-word spelling difference: WER 1/8 and CER 1/46 after normalization. Acceptance limits are WER ≤ 0.125 and CER ≤ 0.05. Both limits must pass; this permits the documented homophone while rejecting larger character changes. Normalization is NFKC, casefolding, curly-to-straight apostrophes, and punctuation removal/tokenization; CER includes the single spaces between normalized tokens. Error rates may exceed 1 when insertions dominate.

The noisy case adds zero-mean Gaussian noise with standard deviation 0.002 using NumPy's default_rng seed 0; it does not modify the stored recording. Silence is a generated two-second zero array and must produce no committed text. These are narrow regression cases, not accent/noise/accuracy certification. Timing measures the engine session with a preloaded model, excluding download/model startup; it is logged without a hosted-runner speed threshold.

The manifest also pins the MIT-declared `Systran/faster-whisper-tiny.en` model to a full commit and SHA256 hashes for every downloaded file. Weights are downloaded explicitly for the opt-in suite and are not committed or bundled in the app. Recordings, weights and first-party test code have distinct licensing scopes. This folder contains no private user dictation.
